dedupe_keys.name: rail stations of the grand paris sud network as re published on municipal portals

description: Rail stations of the Grand Paris Sud network, as re-published on municipal portals is a dataset listed in local open data portals (Opendatasoft), a federated catalogue of open data portals, published or maintained by 10 French local portals re-publishing a national dataset. 10 datasets on 10 portals hold the list of railway and RER stations on the Grand Paris Sud territory, as re-published by the municipalities of the agglomeration. Coverage: France; each copy is limited to the area of its portal (for example Bondoufle, Cesson, Combs-la-Ville, Grand Paris Sud (Essonne and Seine-et-Marne)). The copies sit on: data.combs-la-ville.fr, data.etiolles.fr, data.grandparissud.fr, data.mairie-ris-orangis.fr, data.moissy-cramayel.fr, data.ville-bondoufle.fr, data.ville-cesson.fr, lisses-grandparissud.opendatasoft.com and others. Each copy has its own page, description and export. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-syndicated-local-portals.
